# Real Estate CRM

A mobile-first real estate CRM that helps agents manage listings, leads, showings, and offer negotiations in one fast, field-ready workflow.

## Features

- Mobile-first interface optimized for agents working between appointments and on the go
- Pipeline management for active listings, buyer leads, scheduled showings, and live offers
- Calendar view with property context attached to each showing
- Team and broker visibility for aggregated pipeline oversight without taking away agent autonomy
- MLS sync stub in place so future data integration can be added without blocking the MVP

## Tech stack

- Vanilla HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- FastAPI
- SQLite

## Quick start

1. Start the backend API:
   curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/seed
   uvicorn backend.server:app --reload

2. Open the frontend:
   Open index.html directly in your browser

## Demo login

Use these hardcoded demo credentials to sign in:

- Email: demo@example.com
- Password: demo

The preview currently uses an in-browser fake backend backed by localStorage so you can explore the app without standing up the API. When you deploy the real application, that preview layer is swapped for the FastAPI server in backend/server.py.

## Architecture overview

The project is intentionally simple and MVP-friendly:

- Frontend: a single-page, mobile-first interface built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS
- Preview data layer: a fake backend in the browser using localStorage for instant demo access
- Real backend: FastAPI serves authenticated API endpoints and business logic
- Persistence: SQLite stores users, deals, listings, showings, and offers
- Integration path: the MLS sync stub provides a clean place to connect external listing data later

The current setup keeps development fast for the MVP while preserving a straightforward path to replace the preview backend with the real API-backed implementation.

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)


def test_health_endpoint():
    response = client.get("/api/health")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert "status" in data
    assert data["status"] in {"ok", "healthy", "success"}


def test_login_with_demo_credentials_returns_token():
    payload = {"email": "demo@realestatecrm.com", "password": "demo123"}
    response = client.post("/api/auth/login", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert "token" in data or "access_token" in data


def test_login_with_wrong_credentials_returns_401():
    payload = {"email": "demo@realestatecrm.com", "password": "wrong-password"}
    response = client.post("/api/auth/login", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 401


def test_get_entities_returns_list():
    response = client.get("/api/entities")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)


def test_create_entity_and_get_shows_new_item():
    new_entity = {
        "name": "Test Listing",
        "type": "listing",
        "status": "active",
    }
    create_response = client.post("/api/entities", json=new_entity)
    assert create_response.status_code == 200
    created = create_response.json()
    assert isinstance(created, dict)
    assert created.get("name") == new_entity["name"] or created.get("title") == new_entity["name"]

    get_response = client.get("/api/entities")
    assert get_response.status_code == 200
    items = get_response.json()
    assert isinstance(items, list)
    assert any(
        item.get("name") == new_entity["name"] or item.get("title") == new_entity["name"]
        for item in items
        if isinstance(item, dict)
    )


def test_delete_entity_removes_item():
    entity = {
        "name": "Delete Me",
        "type": "lead",
        "status": "new",
    }
    create_response = client.post("/api/entities", json=entity)
    assert create_response.status_code == 200
    created = create_response.json()
    entity_id = created.get("id") or created.get("entity_id")
    assert entity_id is not None

    delete_response = client.delete(f"/api/entities/{entity_id}")
    assert delete_response.status_code in {200, 204}

    get_response = client.get("/api/entities")
    assert get_response.status_code == 200
    items = get_response.json()
    assert isinstance(items, list)
    assert not any(
        (isinstance(item, dict) and (item.get("id") == entity_id or item.get("entity_id") == entity_id))
        for item in items
    )
